faq.question: How does sterile water differ from bacteriostatic water?
faq.answer: Sterile water contains no antimicrobial preservative, whereas bacteriostatic water includes one. Choose sterile water for single-use dilution or when a preservative would interfere with the assay.

faq.question: Can sterile water be used to reconstitute the peptides in this catalogue?
faq.answer: Yes — it is the conventional choice when a preservative-free vehicle is required. Solubility of the individual peptide should always be checked before adopting a routine protocol.

faq.question: Is this product for human or veterinary use?
faq.answer: No. All catalogue items are supplied strictly for laboratory research use only and are not for human or veterinary use, diagnosis, treatment or cosmetic application.

faq.question: What kit size is supplied?
faq.answer: Sterile water is supplied as 10 mL × 10 vials, with tiered wholesale discounts from 10% at 5+ kits to 30% at 50+ kits.

faq.question: How should the vials be stored?
faq.answer: Store at 2–8 °C protected from light, and do not use vials with damaged seals or visible particulates.
